notes: The interrogative הֲ takes 'shalt' even though English fronts it past the whole temporal clause; the unit is discontinuous under rule 25.
The final 'it' is added: תֵּדָע writes no object marker and no suffix, which is rule 44's own case against folding a supplied object pronoun into the verb.
לָכֵן and לָבֶטַח each fuse to one English word under rule 30, and both articles of בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא are unrepresented because the demonstrative carries the single determiner.
